pages.text: Diving gear is the second tier of underwater gear. Each piece works on its own; the helmet and top together will also take air from an air pump.
pages.title: Diving Gear
Diving Helmet
pages.text: Head slot. Clears the murk under water so you can see much further.

pages.title: Air Supply
pages.text: Chest slot. Worn with the diving helmet, it takes air from a nearby air pump.

pages.title: Diving Suit
pages.text: Leg slot. Blocks you can harvest break twice as fast under water, and oysters come loose almost at once.

pages.title: Diving Boots
pages.text: Feet slot. You swim faster when moving forward under water, and holding sneak sinks you quickly.
